card.name: Linking words before a list
card.fires_on: Small linking words or an opening parenthesis in the middle of a sentence, such as 'and', '(', 'a', 'the' or 'full', where a list or noun phrase is about to continue. It is not tied to one topic.

modes.label: Parenthesis before examples
modes.description: An opening bracket after a symptom phrase, just before 'e.g.'.

modes.label: Linking word in a sentence
modes.description: 'and', 'a' or 'the' in the middle of a sentence, ahead of a noun.
modes.example: provided chemical energy<< and>> other favorable conditions for microbes.

modes.label: Britannica entry note
modes.description: The word 'full' in the closing line sending readers to the full encyclopedia entry.
modes.example: For the<< full>> entry on infinity, visit Britannica.com

card.writes: It slightly raises the word 'mass' as a next word, but the link to these contexts is weak.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in the middle of a sentence, with no one topic.
